mapper.sql: SELECT i.invoice_id, s.shop_id, s.shop_name, p.full_name, d.drink_name, i.created_at, i.total_amount, i.table_number, dd.size, id.quantity, id.unit_price AS price, id.note FROM invoices AS i JOIN invoice_details AS id ON i.invoice_id = id.invoice_id JOIN drink_details AS dd ON id.drink_detail_id = dd.drink_detail_id JOIN drinks AS d ON dd.drink_id = d.drink_id JOIN shops AS s ON i.shop_id = s.shop_id JOIN profiles AS p ON i.profile_id = p.profile_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoices AS i JOIN invoice_details AS id ON i.invoice_id = id.invoice_id JOIN drink_details AS dd ON id.drink_detail_id = dd.drink_detail_id JOIN drinks AS d ON dd.drink_id = d.drink_id JOIN shops AS s ON i.shop_id = s.shop_id JOIN profiles AS p ON i.profile_id = p.profile_id
